description: Verify that TCP in ESTABLISHED enters CLOSE-WAIT on receiving a tester FIN and stays there until application CLOSE (RFC 793 §3.5 p38)
approach:
[Objective]
The passive-close half: tester FIN → DUT acks + transitions ESTABLISHED → CLOSE-WAIT. DUT may still send queued data; it must not emit FIN/RST until user CLOSE.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester ⇄ DUT: handshake.
2. Tester → DUT: FIN.
3. Observation: DUT acks the FIN; if DUT has queued data it sends a data segment in CLOSE-WAIT; no FIN/RST emitted.

[Pass condition]
DUT acks tester FIN + emits queued data + stays in CLOSE-WAIT.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_handshake_ack — handshake never completed
• Fail_no_dut_fin_ack — DUT did not ACK tester FIN
• Fail_no_dut_data — DUT did not send queued data in CW
• Fail_dut_left_cw — DUT emitted FIN or RST in CLOSE-WAIT

verdicts.Pass: DUT entered CLOSE-WAIT and stayed there — normal
verdicts.Fail_no_dut_fin_ack: No DUT ACK to tester FIN in EST
verdicts.Fail_no_dut_data: No DUT data segment in CLOSE-WAIT
verdicts.Fail_dut_left_cw: DUT emitted FIN or RST in CLOSE-WAIT
